changelog: - A name on the board's colleague strip filters the board to that person's leads (`aria-pressed` button; clicking again removes them). On the sales board it is offered only to who may open the team view (`teamRead`) and switches "Mine" to the team view filtered to that person; on the admin board it sets the owner filter (`?owners=`). Dropping a card on a person still opens the hand-off (#3906).

en: Click a colleague's name on the board to see only their leads; click again to see everyone.
tr: Panoda bir ekip arkadaşının adına tıklayınca yalnızca onun lead'lerini görürsün; tekrar tıklayınca herkes geri gelir.
de: Klicke auf dem Board auf den Namen eines Kollegen, um nur dessen Leads zu sehen; ein weiterer Klick zeigt wieder alle.
